about.label: About Résidence Néhémie
about.title: A peaceful place designed for your comfort
about.text1: Located in Bingerville, Résidence Néhémie offers a warm and elegant setting where comfort, tranquillity and hospitality come together.
about.text2: Our furnished apartments are designed to make every stay pleasant, whether you are travelling for business, with family or simply looking for a peaceful getaway.

signature.name: Luxury Room
features: Ideal for short and extended stays
signature.description: A refined apartment offering a peaceful atmosphere and everything you need for a comfortable stay.

elegance.name: 1-bedroom apartment with a living room
elegance.description: A sophisticated space combining modern comfort, practicality and the warm atmosphere of Résidence Néhémie.

prestige.name: 2-bedroom apartment with a living room
prestige.description: An exceptional apartment designed for guests seeking more space, comfort and a refined residential experience.

booking.title: Book your suite
booking.subtitle: The best rates are guaranteed when you book direct. No hidden fees.

map.subtitle: Our location
map.title: Find us easily
map.description: Résidence Néhémie welcomes you in a pleasant setting, ideally located for your stays, business trips and moments of relaxation.

hero.description: Explore our apartments through images and choose the one that suits you best.

images.livingRoom: Bright living room and living space

table.title: The Résidence Néhémie dining experience
table.text: Freshly prepared cuisine to enjoy in a relaxed and welcoming setting.

flavors.title: Flavours from here and beyond
flavors.text: Ivorian dishes, grilled specialties and recipes from around the world.

anywhere.title: A meal wherever you prefer
anywhere.text: Enjoy your meal in the dining area, on the terrace or directly in your apartment.

intro.title: Enjoy great food without leaving the residence
intro.text: At Résidence Néhémie, dining is part of the experience. Our cooks work with fresh, local ingredients to offer simple, generous meals prepared to order, whether you are travelling for business, with family or with friends.

breakfast.title: Breakfast
breakfast.text: Fresh bread, pastries, seasonal fruit, eggs of your choice, coffee and freshly pressed juices to start your day well.

lunchDinner.title: Lunch and dinner
lunchDinner.text: A concise menu that changes regularly, featuring grilled fish and meats, attiéké, alloco, rice dishes and daily specials.

roomService.title: In-apartment dining
roomService.text: Order at reception or via WhatsApp, and we will bring your meal directly to your apartment.

cta.title: Craving something or have a question?
cta.text: Special dietary requirements, group meals or birthdays: let us know in advance and we will take care of the rest.
